NONE: A2 having a larger distance from one side to the other than is usual or expected, especially in comparison with the length of something; not narrow
寬的；寬闊的；寬廣的
B2 farther than usual, or as far as possible
大大地；充分地
B1 used when describing how long the distance between the two sides of something is or when asking for this information
寬度為…的；…寬的
B1 used to describe something that includes a large amount or many different types of thing, or that covers a large range or area
範圍廣闊的；廣泛的
C2 completely, or by a large amount
完全；大大地

example: a wide river/road/gap/foot
寬闊的河流／道路／巨大的裂口／大腳
His eyes were wide (= opened much more than usual) with surprise.
他驚訝得睜大了眼睛。
See also
width
The rectangle is 5 cm long and 1.9 cm wide.
這個長方形長5厘米，寬1.9厘米。
The swimming pool is five metres wide.
這個游泳池有五米寬。
How wide are your skis?
你的滑雪板有多寬？
They sell a wide range of skin-care products.
他們銷售各種各樣的護膚品。
She has a wide experience of teaching, in many different schools.
她先後在多所學校工作過，有豐富的教學經驗。
The idea no longer enjoys wide support (= the support of many people).
這種想法不再受到廣泛支持。
"Open wide," said the dentist.
「張大嘴，」牙醫說。
They moved the fence posts wider apart.
他們將籬笆樁之間的距離拉得更大了些。
She left the door wide open.
她讓門完全敞開著。
It was 3 a.m. and we were still wide awake.
已經是淩晨三點鐘了，我們仍然全無睡意。

NONE: › a man who is dishonest or who deceives people in the way he does business
騙子；不誠實的人

example: Some of the younger property developers are real wide boys.
有些較年輕的房地產開發商是真正的騙子。

NONE: › a camera lens that provides a wider view than usual
廣角鏡頭
› A wide-bodied aircraft is wider and larger than average.
（飛機）寬體的，寬體式的

example: Most of the planes which carry passengers across the Atlantic are wide-bodied jets.
大多數飛越大西洋上空的客機都是寬體噴射機。

NONE: › having your eyes open much wider than usual
睜大眼睛的
› too willing to believe and admire what you see or are told
輕信的；單純的

example: At that time, I was still a wide-eyed youngster.
那時候我仍然是個單純的孩子。

NONE: › covering many subjects
範圍廣的；內容廣泛的

example: a wide-ranging discussion
涉及範圍很廣的討論

NONE: › Wide-set eyes are far apart on someone's face.
（雙眼）間距較寬的

example: The brothers have the same broad forehead and wide-set dark eyes.
兄弟倆都長著寬額頭和分得較開的深色眼睛。

NONE: B2 including a lot of different places, people, subjects, etc.
範圍廣地；廣泛地
B2 to be very different
大不相同

example: They have both travelled widely.
他們倆都遊歷過很多地方。
His plays are still widely performed in the USA.
他的戲劇仍在美國各地上演。
French used to be widely spoken in Cambodia.
在柬埔寨，過去人們普遍講法語。
His work on DNA was widely admired.
他在 DNA 研究方面的工作得到了廣泛讚譽。
This is a widely held but mistaken belief.
這是一種普遍但是錯誤的看法。
This theory is no longer widely accepted.
這一理論不再被人們廣泛接受。
Prices vary widely from shop to shop.
商店之間的價格相差很大。

I or T: B2 to become, or to make something greater in width
B2 to (cause something to) become larger or to include a larger amount or number

example: His eyes/smile widened.
他睜大了眼睛／大笑起來。
Why not widen the discussion to include the Muslim and Jewish points of view?
為甚麼不擴大討論範圍，把伊斯蘭教和猶太教的觀點也包括進來？

NONE: › having a wider than usual screen that shows very clear pictures
（電視機）寬螢幕的
› made to be shown on a screen that is wider than usual
適合以寬螢幕觀看的，寬銀幕的

example: a widescreen version of the movie
寬螢幕版的電影

NONE: C1 existing or happening in many places and/or among many people
廣泛的；普遍的；遍佈的

example: There are reports of widespread flooding in northern France.
有報道說法國北部到處洪水泛濫。
Malnutrition in the region is widespread - affecting up to 78 percent of children under five years old.
這個地區營養不良的現象十分普遍——五歲以下的兒童中78%營養不良。
The campaign has received widespread support.
這場運動得到廣泛支持。

NONE: › informal any small device whose name you have forgotten or do not know
（不知名的）小玩意，小器械，小裝置
› an imagined small product made by a company
（公司的某種）小產品
› a piece of software that is used on a page of a website to give the user changing information of a particular type in a small area of the computer screen
（電腦程式）窗口小工具

example: Let's assume the company makes ten cents profit on every widget they sell.
我們假設該公司每賣一件小產品獲利十美分。
This new widget will bring fresh content to your website every hour.
這個新的視窗小工具每小時都會給你的網站送來新的內容。

NONE: B2 a woman whose husband or wife has died and who has not married again
寡婦，孀婦，遺孀
› a woman whose partner is often not at home because he or she is fishing or playing football or golf
（丈夫因釣魚、踢足球或打高爾夫而經常不在家的）釣魚／足球／高爾夫活寡婦
› If someone has been widowed, their husband or wife has died
喪夫；喪妻
› used to describe a person whose husband or wife has died
守寡的；成鰥夫的；喪偶的

example: a widowed mother of three
一名有3個孩子的寡婦

NONE: › a man whose wife or husband has died and who has not married again
鰥夫
› the state of being a widow or widower
寡居；守寡；鰥居

C or U: B2 [ C or U ] the distance across something from one side to the other
C: › [ C ] the distance across a swimming pool from one side to the other

example: It is five metres in width.
它的寬度是五米。
The needle is seven times smaller than the width of a human hair.
這根針的粗細只有人類頭髮的1/7。
The material is available in various widths.
這種材料有很多種寬度可供選擇。
See also
wide
I managed to swim two widths underwater.
我在泳池裡橫向來回潛遊了一次。
